function: Meta-DDPG learns ISAC BS transmit beamforming, STAR-IRS phase shifts and amplitudes, and SCMA codebook and subcarrier assignment, maximizing energy efficiency under a sensing beam-pattern-error constraint (pp. 4, 8).
system: MISO: ISAC BS with 5 antennas, single-antenna users, simultaneously transmitting and reflecting STAR-IRS with N_S=4 (N_S x N_S UPA), THz band, flat fading (pp. 5, 10).
method: Meta-DDPG: DDPG actor-critic with a learned meta-critic loss (bi-level meta-learning); reinforcement learning with hybrid penalty reward, continuous actions quantized to discrete variables (pp. 8-9).
data_channel: Custom simulated Rician channels (LoS plus NLoS rays) with THz free-space and molecular-absorption path loss, deterministic coefficients, perfect CSI; no standard model, dataset, or measurement (pp. 5-6, 10).
test_conditions: Learning curves over 5000 episodes in one environment per setting; sweeps of learning rate, maximum power, users, multiple access, CSI error; no test on unseen conditions (pp. 10-15).
baselines: Non-learned: convex optimization (AO, Dinkelbach, fractional programming), uniform and random beamforming, NOMA, OFDMA. Learned: DDPG, PPO, SAC, TD3, hybrid MDRL plus Q-learning (pp. 10, 12-14).
metrics: Energy efficiency, reward, total sum rate, total consumed power, time complexity, running time (pp. 10-14).
complexity: Time complexity O(484750) for Meta-DDPG versus O(464700) for DDPG (about 4% more); running time 1502.36 s versus 3969.63 s for convex benchmark (pp. 13-14).
q1_support: p. 5: "The channel coefficients are modeled as Rician channels." Custom THz simulator (p. 6 path loss with molecular absorption); no 3GPP, DeepMIMO, COST 2100, or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 4: "The proposed metalearning can quickly adapt to different conditions." This is only claimed; pp. 10-15 report learning curves per setting, with no test on unseen conditions or reported adaptation.
q3_support: p. 12: "The comparison is between our proposed MDRL, PPO, TD3, SAC, DDPG, uniform beamforming, random beamforming, and Q-learning"; p. 14: "the proposed MDRL outperforms the convex optimization benchmark", both on energy efficiency.
q4_support: p. 13: "The time complexity of the Meta-DDPG algorithm is O(484750) and for DDPG is O(464700)." Running times are also given on p. 14 (1502.36 s versus 3969.63 s).
q5_support: p. 10: "We utilized PyTorch version 1.4.0 for the implementation of Meta-DDPG and DDPG algorithms." No code or data link, DOI, or public dataset is given; channels come from the authors' own simulator.
notes: Area 5 because the learned method does beamforming in an ISAC system (beam-pattern-error constraint, pp. 7-8), which outranks area 3. DDPG could be read as an ablation of Meta-DDPG, but PPO, SAC, and TD3 are separate learned baselines on the same problem (p. 12). Uniform and random beamforming baselines still use MDRL for the other variables (p. 12). Table II (p. 10) and Table I (p. 3) were read from the page images.
